quotes.text: there is growth only by intercalation
an arrangement of intervals, a distribution of inequalities, such that it is sometimes necessary to make a hole in order to consolidate
from a discrete or fuzzy aggregate to its consolidation
Consolidation is not content to come after; it is creative
the beginning always begins in-between, intermezzo
Consistency is the same as consolidation
intercalated elements, intervals, and articulations of superposition
Is not consolidation the terrestrial name for consistency?
iron is intercalated following a rhythm
armature instead of structure
It is no longer a question of imposing a form upon a matter but of elaborating an increasingly rich and consistent material, the better to tap increasingly intense forces
What makes a material increasingly rich is the same as what holds heterogeneities together without their ceasing to be heterogeneous
Meter is dogmatic, but rhythm is critical
rhythm is the Unequal or the Incommensurable that is always undergoing transcoding
A material that is too rich remains too "territorialized"
defined only by a degree of consistency that makes it possible to distinguish the disparate elements constituting that aggregate
a maximum of calculated sobriety in relation to the disparate elements and the parameters
The sobriety of the assemblages is what makes for the richness of the Machine's effects
Sobriety, sobriety: that is the common prerequisite for the deterritorialization of matters
a scribble effacing all lines, a scramble effacing all sounds
works in a material that is not meager but prodigiously simplified, creatively limited, selected
there is no imagination outside of technique
